DefensX has delivered something we’ve been waiting for for some time now. You can tell they have had MSPs in mind from the very start with the design.

DefensX is solid.

Layered Security, Built for Every Organization

From core browser protection to full zero-trust access scale as your security needs grow.

Compare Plans

Phishing resistance on any browser is the foundation of the secure modern workspace

Complete browser security shouldn't be contingent on expensive proprietary browsers or changes to user behavior. With DefensX, 360-degree browser security is seamlessly integrated into any browser. Seamless policy adherence, satisfied users, and uninterrupted efficiency, productivity, and cost-effectiveness.

Download a sample report

Scalable, Zero Trust Governance with Data Policy-Aligned Browser Protection

By aligning the browser with organizational policies and regulations, dynamically filtering content and files, and guarding every session, user, and credential, enterprises and MSPs can boost efficiency, scale effortlessly, and surpass enterprise-grade security standards—achieving Zero Trust by design.

Book a demo to see how

AI driven self healing human risk management and governance

At DefensX, we believe organizations should have seamless, real-time visibility into their entire risk and security posture. Our human risk management dashboard provides automated, in-depth reports on human risk and vulnerabilities, empowering organizations worldwide to effortlessly achieve Zero Trust and cyber resilience.

Book a demo to see how

Replace legacy remote access technologies with any browser

DefensX offers a modern, cost-effective alternative to VDI, enabling organizations to cut costs, strengthen security, and enhance user experience—without the operational challenges of legacy virtual desktops. By shifting secure access controls to the browser, DefensX delivers robust protection without the complexity of traditional VDI solutions.
